newsitem.title: USA: Fairfield files for 2.0 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Fairfield files for 2.0 mln common shares.

text.p: Fairfield Communities Inc filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of up to 2.0 million common shares.
Of the total, Fairfield said it will sell 900,000 shares while Physicians Inc Co of Ohio, a shareholder, will sell up to 1.1 million common shares.
Physicians has granted underwriters an overallotment option for up to 300,000 additional shares.
The underwriters for the offering are Stephens Inc and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp.
Fairfield said proceeds will be used to repay debt and for general corporate purposes. It will not receive any proceeds from the sale by Physicians.
Physicians will reduce its stake to 4.0 percent, from 15.3 percent, when the offering is complete.
